Authors: Vrbančič, G., Fister Jr, I., & Podgorelec, V.
Title: Datasets for phishing websites detection
Key Findings: Constructed comprehensive static feature set without active browsing

Title: Towards benchmark datasets for machine learning based website phishing detection: An experimental study
Key Findings: Random Forest showed highest predictive power; external features strongly discriminative
Limitations: Evaluated static and dynamic features together without SHAP

Title: A Unified Approach to Interpreting Model Predictions
Key Findings: Provides additive feature attribution method with solid theoretical foundations
Limitations: High computation for exact Shapley; TreeSHAP needed

Authors: Mohammad, R. M., Thabtah, F., & McCluskey, L.
Title: Predicting phishing websites based on self-structuring neural network
Key Findings: Neural network achieved 92.18% accuracy on 30 categorical features

Title: XGBoost: A Scalable Tree Boosting System
Key Findings: Tree boosting achieves state-of-the-art tabular accuracy with extreme computational speed

Authors: Adebowale, M. A., Lwin, K. T., & Hossain, M. A.
Title: Intelligent phishing detection system using explainable machine learning
Key Findings: Explainability helps identify critical features and boosts security officer trust
Limitations: High latency when content features are extracted

Authors: Sahoo, D., Liu, C., & Hoi, S. C.
Title: Malicious URL detection using machine learning: A survey
Key Findings: Static lexical features enable fast zero-hour detection without client exposure
Limitations: Survey only; no new experimental pipeline

Authors: Opara, C., Chen, B., & Sadgrove, M.
Title: HTMLPhish: Enabling phishing web page detection by applying deep learning techniques on HTML analysis
Key Findings: Deep learning on raw HTML achieves strong results but incurs huge inference overhead
Limitations: High latency; vulnerable to cloaking and dynamic scripts
Relevance: Contrast to lightweight static URL detection

Title: An Explainable Framework for Phishing Website Detection Based on Machine Learning and SHAP
Key Findings: SHAP value rankings confirm URL length and hyphen counts as primary phishing signals
Limitations: Did not evaluate minimal feature reduction latency

Authors: Alswaimil, A. A., & Altyeb, A. M.
Title: Phishing Website Detection Using Machine Learning Techniques: A Comparative Study
Method: SVM / Decision Tree / Naive Bayes / RF
Key Findings: Tree-based ensembles significantly outperform linear and probabilistic classifiers on tabular URL metrics

Title: A novel framework for phishing detection based on URL and domain features
Key Findings: DNS and lexical features combined provide resilient detection against URL shortening

Title: From local explanations to global understanding with explainable AI for trees
Key Findings: TreeSHAP reduces computation from exponential to polynomial time O(TLD^2)

Title: PD-CNN: Phishing Detection Using Convolutional Neural Networks and URL Statistical Features
Key Findings: Statistical features combined with 1D convolutions give 97.3% detection
Limitations: High model parameters compared to lightweight trees

Title: Detection of Phishing Websites with Machine Learning and Explainable Artificial Intelligence
Key Findings: SHAP explains false positives and helps refine thresholding in real-time deployment
Limitations: Small feature space; lacks extreme dimensionality reduction test

Authors: Gupta, B. B., Yadav, K., & Almomani, A.
Title: Cybersecurity in the Age of Explainable AI: A Comprehensive Survey on Phishing Detection
